subject: SIG/CAIQ packaging + ISO Annex A: ownership & artifact packaging
messages:
From: Auditor Liaison <liaison@cyberassure.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ packaging + ISO Annex A: who owns the artifacts?

Hi Rohan,

We're kicking off the intake for Acme's SIG/CAIQ review alongside an ISO Annex A mapping they requested. To keep the audit window tight, can you confirm:

- The primary owner(s) for ISO Annex A controls (or a mapping to internal control owners).
- A single ZIP or shared folder with representative artifacts for each control (naming convention is helpful).
- Any controls that are fully covered by third-party vendor attestations (please include vendor contact + link to attestation).

Target timeline: Acme's audit window is 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-11. We need the consolidated evidence package by 2026-09-03 to validate scope ahead of the window.

If you prefer, put artifacts in the Drive folder and share ACLs; otherwise attach representative PDFs/CSVs here.

Thanks — we want to avoid last-minute escalations.

— Jordan Bell
Auditor Liaison
CyberAssure Compliance Services

(Attachment: initial-audit-intake-checklist.pdf)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, liaison@cyberassure.com
Date: 2026-08-26T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ packaging + ISO Annex A: who owns the artifacts?

Thanks Jordan — looping in Mina and Olga who are running controls intake and evidence collection.

Plan proposal (quick):
- Owners nominated by 2026-08-31 (control roster attached as a CSV).
- Fill sample artifact slot for each control (1–2 docs each) and drop in the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-compliance-binder
- Use the attached binder template so files are consistently named.

Mina / Olga: can you confirm owners for Annex A controls and drop a first-pass CSV back to me? I'll consolidate and send the bundle to Jordan by Sep 3. If a control is fully subcontracted to a vendor, note the vendor attestation link in the CSV.

If anyone foresees blockers (legal redlines, redacted PII issues), flag now so we can triage.

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.com

(References: attachment: compliance_binder_template_v2.docx)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: liaison@cyberassure.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ packaging + ISO Annex A: who owns the artifacts?

Attached is a first-pass mapping (AnnexA-control-ownership.csv). Quick notes:

- Controls 6.1, 7.2, 10.1 -> Ops (Marissa)
- Controls 9.1, 9.2 (access mgmt) -> IAM (I tagged Markus, will ask him for active policies)
- Controls 11.3 (encryption at rest) -> Platform Security (KMS team). See stubbed KMS key rotation policy attached (kms_key_rotation_policy.pdf).

Vendor-covered controls:
- Logging/monitoring: covered by LogStream (attestation linked in CSV)
- Cloud provider physical controls: vendor SOC report covers these (we referenced in CSV).

I'll start populating the Drive folder over the next two days. If you need specific artifact formats, call out the top 3 priorities and I'll prioritize them.

Mina Haddad
Director, Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

(Attachment: AnnexA-control-ownership.csv; kms_key_rotation_policy.pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: liaison@cyberassure.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-27T15:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ packaging + ISO Annex A: who owns the artifacts?

Thanks — adding a couple operational constraints and a template note: 

- Timeline: privacy team needs 48h for any artifacts that contain customer-identifying metadata; request owners redacting PII where possible.
- Suggested minimal deliverable by Sep 3: (1) control owner CSV, (2) one representative artifact per control, (3) vendor attestations for outsourced controls.
- Attached a cleaned binder template we use for auditors (compliance_binder_template_v2.docx). Please use section headers exactly as in the template to avoid rework during intake.

I'll take ownership of coordinating redaction and the privacy sign-off for any items flagged by Mina.

Olga Petrov
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

(Attachment: compliance_binder_template_v2.docx)

From: Auditor Liaison <liaison@cyberassure.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ packaging + ISO Annex A: who owns the artifacts?

Rohan/Mina/Olga — thanks for the rapid responses and the CSV. That looks good as a starting point. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you confirm a final bundle upload (Drive zip or SFTP) by 2026-09-03 EOD PST? We will run a scope check on Sep 4.
2) Please include a short README.txt at the top level with a control -> filename mapping and redaction notes.

If you prefer to share via our secure intake portal, I can issue a one-time upload link (let me know). Otherwise the Drive link is fine provided ACLs include liaison@cyberassure.com.

We'll reach back with any clarification requests no later than Sep 6.

Appreciate the coordination — Jordan
Jordan Bell
Auditor Liaison
CyberAssure Compliance Services

(Inline note: we prefer PDF artifacts where possible to preserve pagination; where screenshots are used, please include context.)
